## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes made and the business motivation.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] New SQL analytical model
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance optimization

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] Automated 22-rule data quality audit passes (`python python/data_validation.py`)
- [ ] Unit tests pass (`python -m unittest tests/test_data_quality.py -v`)
- [ ] Inline SQL comments document business context and query logic
- [ ] Relevant documentation in `docs/` or `README.md` updated
